app.name: CWL Bonus Calculator
app.tagline: Fair bonus distribution for Clan War Leagues, straight from the official API.
cli.description: Calculate CWL bonus medal distribution from the official Clash of Clans API.
cli.bonuses: Number of bonus medals to award (default: 7).
cli.defense: Include a defensive score (off by default - see docs/SCORING.md).
cli.output: Directory for the generated chart and debug files (default: ./output).
cli.lang: Output language (default: CWL_LANG, else the system locale, else English).
cli.min_wars: Minimum wars played to be eligible for a bonus (default: 0 = everyone).
cli.preset: Weight preset: stars | balanced | hard-target (default: balanced).
cli.preset_help: stars ignores difficulty entirely; balanced rewards hard targets moderately; hard-target rewards them heavily.
cli.difficulty: Override the difficulty weight (points per Town Hall level of difference).
cli.no_defense_policy: Score a player nobody attacked: neutral | min | max (default: neutral).
cli.config: Path to a JSON config file overriding individual weights.
cli.debug: Write per-attack debug detail to the output directory.
cli.rusher_cap: Maximum Town Hall levels the rushed-base correction may remove (default: 2).
cli.list_langs: List the available output languages and exit.
log.logging_in: Logging in to the Clash of Clans API...
error.missing_env: Missing {vars} in your .env file. Copy .env.example to .env and fill it in.
error.bad_credentials: API login failed: the email or password in .env is incorrect.
error.private_war_log: This clan has a private war log, so its CWL data cannot be read.
error.maintenance: The Clash of Clans servers are under maintenance. Try again later.
error.not_in_cwl: This clan is not currently in a Clan War League season.
error.no_group: Could not read the league group for this clan.
error.no_data: No CWL data could be retrieved.
error.no_players: No player took part in a war this season, so there is nothing to rank.
error.unknown_lang: Unknown language '{lang}'. Falling back to English.
